√cakās 'shine'
present: [2.] cakāsti cakāsati etc. cakāśat cakāśete? 
[perfect: cakāsāṃ cakāra acacakāsam acīcakāsam ]
secondary: causative: cakāsayām āsatus

√cakṣ 'see'
present: [2.] cáṣṭe cákṣate etc. V.+ cakṣi cakṣus -- [1.] cakṣate cakṣante etc. cakṣati etc. 
perfect: cacakṣé etc. B.+ cacákṣa acacakṣam 
verbal: caṣṭum -cákṣya V.+ -cákṣe -cákṣi cákṣase 
secondary: passive: cakṣyate etc. E.+ -- causative: cakṣayati etc. 
derivatives: -cakṣ -cakṣā ŚB. -cakṣin AVP. cákṣya V.B. cákṣan AV. cákṣaṇa V.+ cakṣáṇi RV. cákṣas V.B.S. cákṣu V.U. cákṣus V.+
